note: Decision-readiness ledger: one row per requirement line from the project brief. Status, the gate that blocks it, and the number or condition that would clear the gate. Nothing is inferred: every row links the artifact that carries it and a registered official source. This file is maintained by session arena/e15f05e0-own7; rows are re-graded only against artifacts that exist in the tree. Re-graded 2026-11-17 against the official Game Book desk (nfl-gamebook-5213243e, session arena/5213243e-own7, merged via PR #56): DR-10/13/14/21/23/25/31/47/53/58/64 now cite its artifacts, with 13 of 14 Week 10 Game Books captured (the 14th, LAC at BAL, had not kicked off). Re-graded 2026-11-18 by session arena/92cad499-own7 against the completed weeks 1-10 results feed (150 finals; the Week 10 Monday final captured by the 2026-11-18 completion re-read; desk nfl-fresh-1118): DR-02, DR-16, DR-19 and DR-26 numbers updated. DR-33's 149 (depth slots) is an availability-desk count, unrelated to the feed, and is unchanged.

status_values.Implemented: The requirement has a published, source-linked artifact that satisfies it as written.
status_values.Partial: An artifact exists but covers part of the requirement; the gap is named in the gate column.
status_values.Open: No artifact yet; work has not started or cannot start until its gate clears.
status_values.Blocked: Cannot proceed on this source set even with work; the blocker is named (usually official-source rights).
status_values.Rejected: The brief marks this line as a rejected approach; recorded so it is not re-proposed.

requirements.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store recording opening and closing numbers for every originated market
requirements.gate: No official or rights-cleared operator price exists, so market cells stay blank; the store holds model open/close snapshots only.
requirements.clears_when: At least 1 originated market carries an operator OPEN and CLOSE row with a pre-kickoff capture timestamp and a registered source URL.

requirements.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
requirements.gate: The feed extends only as fast as official finals publish. The Week 10 Monday final (LAC 23, BAL 20) was captured by the 2026-11-18 completion re-read of https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-10; Week 11 is published as scheduled fixtures only and contributes no results yet.
requirements.clears_when: Published: 150 official finals captured and reconciled - 160/160 fields against each of the frozen pre-kickoff, 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-18 standings snapshots, plus both snapshot chain identities (fresh17 = frozen + frozen W10 deltas; fresh18 = fresh17 + completion deltas).

requirements.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
requirements.gate: Stage reconciliation must hold on every build (side/total/ML stages must reproduce the single-shot numbers exactly).
requirements.clears_when: 0 of 0 mismatches per build: 14/14 games reconciled in the lifecycle desk and 13 Week 10 games in the competition lab.

requirements.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
requirements.gate: Market line and difference are blank for all rows by rule: no operator publishes a price on any official page this project read; difference computes only when both inputs exist.
requirements.clears_when: 1 market row with a market_line value on a rights-cleared host; difference fills on the next rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
requirements.gate: The staking half stays empty until an executable price exists; ranking reads signal fields only (test-enforced).
requirements.clears_when: Staking table has at least 1 price-verified row; signal ranking is provably independent of staking fields.

requirements.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
requirements.gate: Depth rank is only as good as the printed chart: HOU publishes an image, so 1 of 32 clubs has no chart evidence.
requirements.clears_when: 326 injury rows joined to printed charts; 173 starter losses, 158 named replacements, depth-of-replacement per row (31/32 clubs).

requirements.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
requirements.gate: Every published coefficient must carry n and registered sources; 2 of 24 candidate values are left blank rather than estimated.
requirements.clears_when: 22 audit rows pass with n >= 3 and sources; blanks carry stated reasons (0 failures, build aborts otherwise).

requirements.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
requirements.gate: Nothing is live, so the gate is armed and idle; triggers are pre-registered with fixed thresholds.
requirements.clears_when: 10 published triggers with today's reading; a strategy reaching live tier activates monitoring (D1-D5 / DG-1).

requirements.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
requirements.gate: Requires the freeze-before-results workflow to be followed for every new strategy (commit hash is the registration).
requirements.clears_when: Leaderboard shows only forward-graded rows; backtest artifacts live on separate pages (0 qualified strategies today).

requirements.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (who was expected to start, who actually did)
requirements.gate: Actual starters now exist for 13 Week 10 games from official Game Books (550 rows); the expected-starter join is not computable because per-game club depth charts were captured for 0 of the 26 playing clubs by the Game Book desk.
requirements.clears_when: Expected starters (official printed charts) joined to actual starters (official Game Book lineups) for a full slate; multi-week history after that.

requirements.requirement: Do not model depth from jersey order; model it from playing time
requirements.gate: No official snap-count source has been verified for all 32 clubs; jersey order is explicitly rejected as a depth source.
requirements.clears_when: An official snap-count publication verified club-by-club (32/32) and joined to the depth ledger.

requirements.requirement: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level
requirements.gate: Holds as a design rule: no point value is attached to an injury or replacement; deltas are published, levels are not used as features.
requirements.clears_when: Every published availability feature is a change from the prior snapshot (surprise), with the level kept only as context.

requirements.requirement: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep before any team-level model is trusted
requirements.gate: Roster and reserve/IR lists are still not captured; the Game Book desk documents the named gaps (Malik Willis absent from the report; the Baltimore stale-depth claim not re-verifiable without an official reserve list).
requirements.clears_when: 32/32 clubs' roster + IR + transactions captured same-day and reconciled against the injury report.

requirements.requirement: Add a fixture-context feature set built only from published schedule facts
requirements.gate: Roof, surface and game-day weather are now captured per Game Book for 13 Week 10 games; NWS hourly forecast grids are not joined and no other week is captured.
requirements.clears_when: NWS hourly grids joined to the official roof/surface designations for one full slate without inference.

requirements.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick
requirements.gate: Applies to originated markets; stored artifacts carry the model inputs (ratings, HFA, shrinkage) with each output.
requirements.clears_when: Every board row exposes its fair probability and input parameters (78 market rows in the competition lab).

requirements.requirement: Compute and publish the 'removal of luck' panel on the site dashboard
requirements.gate: Luck analysis needs a settled sample; currently 134 scored rows (weeks 2-10, 150-final completed corpus).
requirements.clears_when: Published: exact binomial null, luck band at observed n, required sample size, permutation p and BH q per candidate.

requirements.requirement: Add a two-sided 'what would change our mind' field to every strategy entry
requirements.gate: The decision-record ballot exists with two-sided fields, but 0 decisions are recorded (a person owns the ballot); not every legacy strategy row carries both fields yet.
requirements.clears_when: Every strategy row exposes falsifier AND reverser fields; at least the 12 ranked proposals carry them.

requirements.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
requirements.gate: No official source publishes a price (nfl.com/odds returns 404); operator prices are third-party and rights-restricted (XS09/CF10).
requirements.clears_when: A rights-cleared price source agreed in writing, then residuals publish on a fixed schedule from the next slate.

requirements.requirement: Turn the game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
requirements.gate: The corpus is one season of official finals; walk-forward scoring starts at week 2 (week 1 has no prior).
requirements.clears_when: 134 rows scored leakage-free across weeks 2-10 with frozen parameters (completed 150-final feed, 2026-11-18).

requirements.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
requirements.gate: Policy flags exist (XS09 source rights, CF10 third-party attribution) but a written owner decision is not recorded.
requirements.clears_when: A written answer on record: consent obtained, a different source used, or the price work formally declined (SG-12).

requirements.requirement: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta, never the level
requirements.gate: Reads are dated and the Game Book desk publishes a delta vs the prior capture (300 rows); a clock-timestamped multi-day series still does not exist (terms gate on scheduled capture).
requirements.clears_when: Each capture stores a fetch timestamp and the computed delta vs the prior capture (needs multi-capture storage).

requirements.requirement: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it
requirements.gate: Rows are re-graded only when their artifact changes; the table must stay in sync with the desks.
requirements.clears_when: This table (65 rows) renders on the landing page with per-row gate and clearing condition (2026-11-17).

requirements.requirement: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre
requirements.gate: 13 of the 14 Week 10 fixtures have their venue, stadium, roof/surface, weather and attendance transcribed from the official Game Book PDF (raw capture + SHA-256 retained); the 14th (LAC at BAL) had no Game Book at the read.
requirements.clears_when: Venue transcribed for every fixture of the week (14/14) and repeated for a second week.

requirements.requirement: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
requirements.gate: The announcement text is fixed by the league; the page must be re-read when flexible-scheduling decisions post.
requirements.clears_when: 2026 TBD-games announcement (Weeks 16-18 windows, flexible-scheduling procedures link) recorded beside the Week 10 schedule evidence (2026-11-17).

requirements.requirement: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status; do not infer depth rank or snaps
requirements.gate: Official Game Books are now the source for actual starters, Not Active lists, venue, roof/surface and weather for 13 of 14 Week 10 games; one week is captured and one fixture is pending.
requirements.clears_when: Game Book capture repeated for subsequent weeks (13-14 per week) and joined to the availability ledger.

requirements.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
requirements.gate: Ratings refresh weekly as finals publish; they are opponent-aware within the captured season only.
requirements.clears_when: Walk-forward ratings built from 150 game-level results (weeks 1-10 complete, 2026-11-18), prior state strictly before the target week.

requirements.requirement: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties (with and without personnel features, uncertainty reported)
requirements.gate: Requires verified availability features over multiple weeks; today's capture is one week deep.
requirements.clears_when: Same model run with and without personnel features on chronological holdouts; difference reported with uncertainty.

requirements.requirement: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties, using chronological holdouts
requirements.gate: Same gate as DR-27; the fixed-penalty approach is explicitly not used.
requirements.clears_when: Identical models with and without verified availability features compared on holdout weeks.

requirements.requirement: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots (daily capture with retained hashes)
requirements.gate: NFL.com terms section 1.3 prohibits systematic retrieval to compile a collection without written consent; scheduled scraping is off by policy.
requirements.clears_when: Written consent obtained, or a permitted low-frequency capture design agreed; captures then land daily with hashes.

requirements.requirement: Build immutable official availability snapshots (reports, depth pages, inactive evidence with hashes and conflict flags)
requirements.gate: Single dated captures with saved verbatim evidence exist; hashes and conflict flags exist per capture, not per day.
requirements.clears_when: Multiple dated captures per week retained with hashes (after DR-29's gate) or per-game inactive evidence joined.

requirements.requirement: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts (only 6 of 254 report rows carried a game designation)
requirements.gate: Official Not Active lists are now captured for 13 Week 10 games (146 rows with designation and jersey); snap counts and snap shares are still not captured from any official source.
requirements.clears_when: Inactive evidence held for a second slate plus an official snap-count source verified club-by-club.

requirements.requirement: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage (Texans image chart; Packers jersey-number prefix)
requirements.gate: Packers rows recover via number stripping + raw-string retention; the Texans chart is an image with no authorized structured equivalent.
requirements.clears_when: 31/32 clubs parse (current state); HOU clears only via an authorized structured source, never transcription by eye.

requirements.requirement: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter (149 slots list more than one rank-1 player)
requirements.gate: Holds for the captured week; a new week's chart re-derives the groups.
requirements.clears_when: 149 club/unit/position slots published as printed groups (shared and empty slots preserved).

requirements.requirement: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event (depth/availability evidence versioned against the last official roster event)
requirements.gate: Transactions are read and flagged (Baltimore stale rows; Colts same-article trades) but not captured as a versioned register.
requirements.clears_when: A dated transactions register exists and depth rows carry the roster-event version they were valid at.

requirements.requirement: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
requirements.gate: The shadow baseline is graded prospectively from the originated board; nothing is promoted while the price gate blocks staking.
requirements.clears_when: Team-strength model frozen, versions recorded, forecasts recorded pre-kickoff (board rows qualify; 0 live today).

requirements.requirement: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
requirements.gate: Multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence; combos rank only with a directly validated joint probability and operator void/push rules.
requirements.clears_when: Measured leg dependence (phi -0.0386, p=0.666, n=127) is published; no combo is ranked until a joint probability exists.

requirements.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions (singles, game parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos)
requirements.gate: Divisions exist for singles and game-level markets; SGP and prop-combo divisions have no eligible rows (joint gate unmet).
requirements.clears_when: All four divisions published with benchmark-relative skill and uncertainty; empty divisions state why.

requirements.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate (Brier skill, game-cluster lower bound, multiplicity adjustment)
requirements.gate: Applies to graded candidates; qualification requires every gate to pass including multiplicity control.
requirements.clears_when: 30 variants graded; 0 qualified, 1 provisional; BH q-values and permutation p-values published per candidate.

requirements.requirement: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts (immutable captures outside the static site, freshness monitoring, source-change alerts)
requirements.gate: No storage outside the static site exists in this project yet; CI freshness checks cover the committed snapshots only.
requirements.clears_when: An out-of-repo immutable store with a freshness monitor and a source/schema-change alert wired to the capture job.

requirements.requirement: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer (raw row-level data held back until terms are read)
requirements.gate: The public site publishes derived analysis with per-row sources; there is no separate private store — raw rows live in the repository pending the terms decision.
requirements.clears_when: Raw row-level data moves behind the private layer once the terms answer (DR-20) is recorded.

requirements.requirement: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
requirements.gate: View covers the captured Week 10 window; extends as new weeks are captured.
requirements.clears_when: Club-level summary published per club (starters out, named replacements, depletion counts).

requirements.requirement: Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
requirements.gate: League-published dated starter changes are captured where the report prints them; announced-change evidence is not yet a per-row field everywhere.
requirements.clears_when: Every replacement row distinguishes club-announced starters from chart-inferred ones (blank when unannounced).

requirements.requirement: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
requirements.gate: Register covers 31 of 32 clubs (HOU image gate, DR-32).
requirements.clears_when: 1,815 printed depth-chart slots across 31 clubs, each row with club, date and registered source.

requirements.requirement: Calibrate what 'Questionable' means empirically instead of using old percentages
requirements.gate: Requires multiple seasons of designations joined to official inactive lists; one season is captured.
requirements.clears_when: Play rate per designation with confidence intervals computed over joined seasons; only then may it become a feature.

requirements.requirement: Interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st-4th string)
requirements.gate: Matrix depth is bounded by printed chart depth (4 ranks) and by the HOU gap; it is a static published table with site filtering.
requirements.clears_when: Trench and coverage mismatches published from 1,815 printed slots (e.g., WR1 vs promoted 2nd/3rd-string CB).

requirements.requirement: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log (Baltimore case)
requirements.gate: Flags are as of the captured week; they must be re-checked against new transactions every week.
requirements.clears_when: Stale rows flagged with transaction evidence (VR-17, VR-26; VQ-07) and published non-blocking.

requirements.requirement: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for injuries, depth charts and inactives (prevents lookahead leakage)
requirements.gate: A point-in-time ledger now exists for the Week 10 Game Book artifacts (capture time, SHA-256, source URL, vintage); the other desks' captures predate it and are dated but not hash-ledgered.
requirements.clears_when: Every backtest input resolves to a hash-ledgered capture whose timestamp precedes the event being forecast.

requirements.requirement: Populate the three missing Lions game-status designations
requirements.gate: Corrected against the official article (VR-08, VR-12); correction must be re-verified whenever the report is re-read.
requirements.clears_when: Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed published as Out with the official article linked.

requirements.requirement: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables
requirements.gate: Stale counts (254 rows) were replaced by the live capture (279 rows, 2 no-injury sections).
requirements.clears_when: 279-row capture with Seattle (15) and Cincinnati (4) listed correctly, published with sources (VR-04..VR-07).

requirements.requirement: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
requirements.gate: None — recorded as rejected so it is not re-proposed.
requirements.clears_when: n/a (rejected).

requirements.requirement: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully (Seattle two-in-one-slot; Washington empty slot)
requirements.gate: Holds for the captured week; every new week re-derives.
requirements.clears_when: Shared and empty slots preserved as printed (VR-21, VR-23; VQ-08), not rendered as a ranked list.

requirements.requirement: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature (club charts first, then snap counts)
requirements.gate: Route (a) verified for 31/32 clubs; route (b) (snap counts) unverified; HOU blocks completion.
requirements.clears_when: One route verified for all 32 clubs; only then is the deficiency feature built league-wide.

requirements.requirement: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
requirements.gate: A first empirical table exists (Out 10/14 inactive, Questionable 3/11, Wilson 95% intervals, n published) from one week joined to official Not Active lists; several seasons of designations are still required before the label becomes a feature.
requirements.clears_when: Reliability table computed over multiple seasons of designations joined to inactive lists; the feature decision is recorded after that.

requirements.requirement: Snapshot the nfl.com injury report every Wed, Thu and Fri and keep a dated history
requirements.gate: Same terms gate as DR-29 (systematic retrieval); day-level history exists only for captured weeks.
requirements.clears_when: Permitted capture schedule agreed in writing; history then accrues Wed/Thu/Fri with retained hashes.

requirements.requirement: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series, not a weekly snapshot
requirements.gate: Captures are dated but the Wed-to-kickoff daily series does not exist (DR-54 gate).
requirements.clears_when: Designation evolution (Questionable to Out; DNP to FP) measurable across at least one full report week.

requirements.requirement: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable
requirements.gate: No official snap-count source verified (DR-11 gate); HOU remains the motivating case.
requirements.clears_when: A verified official snap-count source produces a starter/backup split for the clubs without printed charts.

requirements.requirement: Add a control baseline (random picks; favorites only) to every leaderboard run
requirements.gate: Controls run with the same grading; one control's null rejection (34.0% vs coin) is reported as a property of the test, not an edge.
requirements.clears_when: Every leaderboard run includes both controls alongside the strategy family.

requirements.requirement: Stadium roof/surface and NWS hourly wind/precipitation overlay with official 90-minute roof designations
requirements.gate: Official roof/surface designations and game-day weather are captured per Game Book for 13 Week 10 games; the NWS hourly wind/precipitation grids are still not joined, so totals/weather mispricing cannot be tested yet.
requirements.clears_when: NWS hourly grids joined to the official 90-minute roof designations for one full slate, each value source-linked.

requirements.requirement: Two-stage skill leaderboard: proper-score qualification then prospective CLV/ROI escrow
requirements.gate: Stage 1 (Brier qualification + BH control) runs; stage 2 escrow holds 0 rows because no price exists (DR-01 gate).
requirements.clears_when: At least one qualified strategy reaches the prospective stage with an executable price to escrow.

requirements.requirement: Vig-free market consensus vs originated fair-line decomposition view
requirements.gate: The pricing desk holds 136 attributed closing-price observations from Pro-Football-Reference (third party); no official consensus exists and vig-free decomposition needs the price policy decision (DR-20).
requirements.clears_when: Rights answer recorded and a consensus price set validated; decomposition then published with residuals.

requirements.requirement: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
requirements.gate: Weekly snapshots exist as dated evidence files; no diff view is rendered between consecutive weeks.
requirements.clears_when: At least 2 weekly snapshots stored and a rendered diff (rank change, rating change, availability change) published.

requirements.requirement: Publish every model total twice until one wins (two estimators with a gap column, collapsed only after walk-forward)
requirements.gate: The canonical engine publishes one total per game; the market desk and the competition lab publish their own estimators, but the three have not been collapsed by a walk-forward comparison.
requirements.clears_when: Both estimators visible with the gap column; walk-forward comparison decides the collapse (or the desks stay separate).

requirements.requirement: Add a drift alarm to every scraper (pin parsers to row counts and required fields; fail the build loudly)
requirements.gate: Canonical parsers abort on contradiction and CI pins expected counts; desk scrapers have per-desk guards but there is no unified alarm surface.
requirements.clears_when: Every extraction path aborts the build on missing fields or row-count drift, with the failure surfaced on a flagged page.

requirements.requirement: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available' (Malik Willis case)
requirements.gate: The reserve/IR list is still not retrieved; the Game Book desk documents the named consequences (Malik Willis absent from the report; the Baltimore stale-depth claim unverifiable without the list).
requirements.clears_when: IR/reserve capture joins the report capture for all 32 clubs, so absent-but-reserved players are labeled.

requirements.requirement: Reject: ranking strategies by season-long ROI
requirements.gate: None — recorded as rejected.
requirements.clears_when: n/a (rejected).

requirements.requirement: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons (for Q06)
requirements.gate: The league does not publish a past-season injury-report archive this project can read; constructing one would require systematic retrieval (DR-29 gate).
requirements.clears_when: An official archive located, or seasons accrue forward one week at a time under a permitted schedule.

requirements.requirement: Pre-register each strategy (definition frozen before results are seen)
requirements.gate: Registration is the commit hash; every new strategy must follow it before its evaluation window opens.
requirements.clears_when: Frozen rule text, sample window and gates committed before evaluation (DG-1 and board parameters are registered).

requirements.requirement: 2026 kickoff and declared onside-kick regime priors filter
requirements.gate: The 2026 playing-rules changes (kickoff/onside declarations) are not yet transcribed from the official rulebook into the model context.
requirements.clears_when: Declared rules transcribed from the official 2026 playing rules and the priors filter added with its source.

requirements.requirement: Freeze a rule before it sees data (commit hash is the registration)
requirements.gate: Holds for every evaluation window; violations are a governance flag.
requirements.clears_when: Rule text, sample window and gates committed before the window opens (enforced by review workflow).

requirements.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
requirements.gate: Only one season is captured; a final holdout season cannot exist yet.
requirements.clears_when: At least 3 seasons of official results archived, then the split is frozen before the holdout is scored.
